market_analysis.market_type_reason: B2B: buyers are wound-care, device and pharmaceutical-packaging makers and hospitals' suppliers.
market_analysis.market_definition: The Global Medical Films Market comprises specialized polymer-based films used in medical devices, wound care products, pharmaceutical packaging and healthcare applications. These films are manufactured using materials such as thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polyester (PET) and other medical-grade polymers. Key applications include transparent wound dressings, surgical drapes, catheter securement films, NPWT dressing films, medical device components and sterile medical packaging.
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player itself manufactures medical-grade polymer FILMS (TPU, PE, PP, PET or other medical-grade polymer films, by extrusion, casting, coating or lamination) and sells them under its own name for transparent wound dressings, surgical drapes and incise films, catheter securement, NPWT dressings, medical device components or sterile medical packaging -- including film and packaging groups for which medical films are one business line, and makers of film-based medical products (film dressings, drapes) who produce the film themselves.
adjacent_segments: Polymer resin, compound and masterbatch suppliers (they sell the raw material, not films)
Device, dressing or kit assemblers that only buy films from others
Film makers with no medical-grade or healthcare film products
Distributors and traders of other companies' films
Rigid medical packaging (trays, bottles, blisters of thick rigid sheet) without medical films

market_participants.definition: Companies that produce the physical medical-grade films, barrier laminates, and co-extruded structures under their own brand names.
market_participants.why_relevant: They are the direct producers controlling the material formulations, cleanroom manufacturing standards, and regulatory compliance required by healthcare buyers.

market_participants.definition: Companies that buy rollstock medical films to print, slit, or form them into finished medical pouches and bags.
market_participants.why_relevant: They act as intermediate structural participants that add value to the film before it reaches the final medical device or pharma OEM.

market_analysis.primary_reason: Manufacturer: the players produce medical-grade polymer films (extruded, cast, coated or laminated).
